meta.title: Cross-Platform Developer
meta.tagline: Write once, deploy everywhere — mobile, web and desktop.
meta.description: Cross-platform developers build applications that run on multiple platforms from a single codebase using frameworks like Flutter (Dart) or React Native (JavaScript). They balance platform-specific behavior with code sharing efficiency.
